review: The Ring Fauvist Student Meursault (shortened to Ring Meursault) is a welfare event unit released alongside Ring Rodion. While being a Bleed and Sinking unit, he is strongly leaning towards Bleed infliction. His Main gimmick - infliction of Mauled Colour [Rouge], which is meant for increasing potency ramp-up and “sticky” debuff source for other ring IDs. Let’s go through his unique effects more thoroughly: - Mauled Color [Rouge] - This effect inflicts bonus Bleed Potency on hit (three maximum) and up to 2 Defense Level Down at the end of turns. - Le Fauvisme - Masque de Chien - A self buff he gains after inflicting 10 Mauled Color [Rouge] stacks. It gives him a minor damage buff and increased Bleed potency infliction. - Imperfections Addressed - Another self-damage buff that he gains from Ring Rodion while she uses her counter - 2. It lasts as long as her buff from counter - 2. Additiona
